questions.question: Nonkhululeko Thabethe set a database record (List A) with a value of 154. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Matches Played', held by Nonkhululeko Thabethe.

questions.question: At which ground did E Conradie record their career-best bowling figures (2-28, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval, against Lions on 2007/03/25.

questions.question: Who has achieved the century and 4 wickets in a match double more times, Mieke van Voorst or Suné Luus?
questions.explanation: Mieke van Voorst: 1 times. Suné Luus: 2 times.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Fastest 50 (by balls)' in the 08/09 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Shandré Fritz holds it, with a total of 49.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Badgers or Knights?
Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2019 season?
questions.explanation: Dané van Niekerk won it in 2019.
